title: Breath Garden
subtitle: A little wind unfolds a world.
description: Send wind through an original coral-and-blue paper garden with a held button or Space. Optional, explicitly enabled local microphone loudness opens the same folds, with no recording or uploads.
medium: Paper garden and optional local sound input
instruction: Hold the blue wind button, hold Space, or press the garden to open the paper flowers. Microphone input is optional and starts only when you enable it.
